tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The allegations primarily pertain to passing on the input tax credit to the insurance company i.e. Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Ltd. without supply on manpower services in violation of Section 16, 31 & 35 of the CGST Act, 2017 read with Rule 36, 46 & 56 of the CGST Rules, 2017 read with Section 20 of the IGST Act, 2017.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Office of the Commissioner of CGST and CEX. (Appeals-III), Mumbai
tax_litigation.status: The Company has received an Order-in-Appeal dated 30.06.2026 on 20.07.2026. An appeal shall be filed with Goods and Services Tax Appellate Tribunal in this regard.
